responses.sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price, AVG(1.0 * Bytes / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804

assumptions.assumption: A large track has more than 10323804 bytes; the average ratio is calculated from each track's Bytes divided by Milliseconds. A zero Milliseconds value has no defined ratio.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff is inclusive, so tracks with exactly 10323804 bytes are large.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price, AVG(1.0 * Bytes / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track WHERE Bytes >= 10323804

responses.sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price, AVG(1.0 * Bytes / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track WHERE Bytes >= 10323804;

assumptions.assumption: A track at the cutoff counts as large. The bytes-per-millisecond result is the average of each track's ratio; a zero duration has no defined ratio and is ignored by AVG.

alternatives.interpretation: Only tracks strictly above the cutoff count as large.
